upright.short: Loss, disappointment, regret, grief, emotional pain.
upright.general: The Five of Cups symbolizes sadness, emotional disappointment, regret, and focusing on what has been lost. A person may struggle to move on from painful experiences or missed opportunities. The card reminds that hope and support still remain, even in difficult times.
upright.in_love: Heartbreak, disappointment, emotional distance, or regret in relationships. Old wounds or unresolved emotions may interfere with harmony.
upright.in_situation: The situation may involve setbacks, emotional frustration, or disappointment. It is important not to lose hope and to recognize the possibilities that still remain.
upright.meaning_for_today: Today may bring disappointment, regret, or emotional sadness. However, not everything is lost — support and new opportunities still remain nearby.
upright.card_advice: Do not focus only on losses and failures. Accept the past, allow yourself to heal, and notice the opportunities that still exist.

reversed.short: Healing, acceptance, emotional recovery, moving forward.
reversed.general: Reversed, the Five of Cups indicates emotional healing, acceptance of the past, and recovery after disappointment. A person begins to let go of pain and open up to new possibilities.
reversed.in_love: Reconciliation, emotional healing, forgiveness, or readiness to move on from past relationship pain.
reversed.in_situation: The situation gradually improves as emotional wounds heal and optimism returns. There is an opportunity for renewal and positive change.
reversed.meaning_for_today: Today may bring emotional healing, acceptance, and the ability to leave past disappointments behind. Gradually, hope and emotional clarity return, helping you see new possibilities for the future.
reversed.card_advice: Allow yourself to release old pain and stop dwelling on what cannot be changed. Forgiveness, self-compassion, and openness to new experiences will help you move forward emotionally.
